newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-MEDVEDEV ADDS TO LIST OF BEATEN SEEDS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MEDVEDEV ADDS TO LIST OF BEATEN SEEDS.

text.p: The Australian hardcourt tennis championship lost another seed on Tuesday when Andrei Medvedev of the Ukraine was beaten in straight sets by U.S. player Jonathan Stark.
Stark thrashed Medvedev 6-1 6-1 to move through to the second round.
Medvedev's defeat came after a similar straight sets drubbing suffered by top seed and defending champion Yevgeny Kafelnikov of Russia at the hands of Sweden's Mikael Tillstrom on Monday.
Stark will meet Jonas Bjorkman in the second round after Bjorkman disposed of fellow Swede Nicklas Kulti 7-5 6-1.

Eighth seed Bohdan Ulihrach of the Czech Republic made it through to the second round with a 6-4 6-4 win over Venezuela's Nicolas Pereira. Ulihrach's next opponent is Australian wild card entry Scott Draper, a 6-3 3-6 6-3 winner over Alex Radulescu of Germany.

Patrick Rafter of Australia had little trouble in overcoming U.S. qualifier Jeff Salzenstein 6-4 6-3 while fiery American Jeff Tarango beat Martin Damm of the Czech Republic 6-3 6-3. Rafter, who slipped from 20 to 62 in the world rankings after an injury-plagued year, will next meet Andrei Cherkasov of Russia.
In another first round match, Sweden's Thomas Johansson beat Spaniard Galo Blanco 6-4 6-3.
Mark Woodforde was the only one of the top three seeds to survive the first round after the second-seeded Australian defeated compatriot Richard Fromberg on Monday.
Woodforde's next opponent is Slovakia's Karol Kucera after Kucera beat Sandon Stolle of Australia 6-1 4-6 6-0.
